hmda.source: Committed HMDA New Jersey slice (data/hmda/new-jersey/county_market_summary_nj.csv), Somerset County row. Properties located in Somerset County. Not a second national download.
hmda.caveat: HMDA describes reporting institutions in the statutory HMDA universe for properties located in this county. It does not describe all lending activity. Denial rate is denials divided by applications. It is not a quality score, approval probability, or fair-lending conclusion. Disparity does not prove discrimination.

njhmfa.copy: Eligible borrowers may qualify for up to $15,000 in NJHMFA Down Payment Assistance, plus $7,000 first-generation assistance where eligible (potential combined up to $22,000).
njhmfa.caveat: County of the property does not by itself qualify a borrower. Amounts are 'up to' and require program eligibility. NJHMFA participation is not an endorsement.

land_records.copy: AcclaimWeb requires a free account (email activation). After that, the public can search recorded instruments by name, book/page, instrument number, legal description, document type, consideration, and record date. Sessions are not automated here. The Clerk will not run a title search. A recorded mortgage is not a current loan balance.

property.source_name: Somerset County Parcels FeatureServer (documented count) and Tax Parcel Viewer
property.daniels_law: Owner information is redacted under Daniel's Law. This page does not publish owner names.
property.copy: The county Parcels FeatureServer documented 132,911 tax-parcel features as of 2026-04-30 (last checked 2026-09-03). That is not a housing-unit or household count, and it is not a re-acquired NJGIN warehouse. The official Tax Parcel Viewer is available for interactive research. Assessment is not appraisal. Owner names are not shown.

findings.title: 2025 mortgage application mix
findings.body: The committed 2025 HMDA county slice recorded 11,584 applications, 6,702 originations, and 1,793 denials for properties in Somerset County (15.48% denial rate, denials ÷ applications). Purchase applications were 38.90% of applications and refinance applications were 34.06%. Conventional applications were 89.99% of the county mix, with FHA 7.86%, VA 2.06%, and USDA/other 0.09%. Denial rate is not a quality score.

findings.title: NJHMFA down-payment geography
findings.body: Somerset is in NJHMFA's 12-county group. Eligible borrowers may qualify for up to $15,000 in Down Payment Assistance, plus $7,000 first-generation assistance where eligible (potential combined up to $22,000). County of the property does not by itself establish borrower eligibility.

findings.title: Land-record research access and property context
findings.body: AcclaimWeb land records require a free account and are not automated here. A land-record search is not a title report. The county parcels service documented 132,911 features as of 2026-04-30; parcel count is not household count. No structured sheriff-sale status snapshot was acquired, and that gap is not published as zero sales.

lender_discovery.copy: Use the New Jersey lender catalog and the existing Somerset County catalog page to research lenders. A headquarters or city listed in this county does not mean the lender serves only this county. HMDA county activity is not a New Jersey license roster. Individual mortgage loan originators are not published from this page.
